channelSettingsPage.title: Channel Settings
channelSettingsPage.subtitle: Define how this channel executes trades on your MT account.

eligibility.title: Symbol & trade eligibility
eligibility.subtitle: Control which symbols this channel can trade and how many positions it can open.

risk.title: Risk & position sizing
risk.subtitle: Define how trades are sized and how much you risk per trade.

incompleteSignal.title: Incomplete signals
incompleteSignal.subtitle: Define how to handle signals missing entry, SL, or TP.

management.title: Trade management
management.subtitle: Manage open positions using break-even, trailing stop, and TP rules.

symbols.title: Allowed symbols
symbols.subtitle: Select which symbols this channel is allowed to trade. Based on your connected MT account.
symbols.modeDescriptionAll: The account catalog decides which symbols are executable.
symbols.modeDescriptionSelected: Only the exact broker symbols selected below can be traded.
symbols.accountRequired: Link a connected MT account to load the exact tradable symbol catalog.
symbols.noneSelected: No symbol filter set. This channel can trade all symbols available in your MT account.
symbols.catalogEmpty: No symbol data available. Connect and sync your MT account to load symbols.
symbols.loadError: We couldn't load the tradable symbols for this account. Refresh the page and try again.

limits.title: Trade limits
limits.subtitle: These limits prevent the channel from opening new trades.

active.title: Max active trades
active.description: Maximum number of open positions from this channel at the same time.

daily.title: Max trades per day
daily.description: Maximum number of trades this channel can open per UTC day.

duplicateTimeout.title: Duplicate signal timeout
duplicateTimeout.description: Minutes before the same matching signal can be accepted again.

risk.title: Risk & position sizing
risk.subtitle: Configure lot size and risk per trade.

fixed.label: Fixed cash risk
fixed.description: Risk a fixed amount on every trade.

percentage.label: Equity percentage
percentage.description: Risk a percentage of your equity. Lot size is calculated automatically.

fixedLot.label: Fixed lot size
fixedLot.description: Use a fixed lot size. Trades are skipped if not allowed by your broker.

maxLots.label: Max lot size
maxLots.description: Optional cap on the final lot size after all calculations.

maxSlPips.label: Max SL distance
maxSlPips.description: Set the maximum SL pips accepted for a signal. Signals with SL pips greater than this value are discarded. Leave blank to disable this limit.

tp1VsSlGuard.label: Reject when SL is greater than TP1
tp1VsSlGuard.description: Discard signals where the stop-loss distance is greater than the TP1 distance.

minLotsOverride.label: Use broker minimum lot
minLotsOverride.description: If calculated lot is below the broker minimum, use the minimum instead of skipping the trade.

lotRoundingMode.label: Lot rounding
lotRoundingMode.description: Define how lot size is rounded to match broker lot steps.

executionFlex.title: Incomplete signals
executionFlex.subtitle: Define behavior when signals are missing entry, SL, or TP.

allowWithoutSlTp.label: Allow trades without SL/TP
allowWithoutSlTp.description: Execute trades even if SL or TP is missing.

allowProviderSlWidening.label: Allow provider SL widening
allowProviderSlWidening.description: High risk: allow a provider update to move the stop loss farther from safety.

allowForwardedSignals.label: Allow forwarded signals
allowForwardedSignals.description: Copy signals forwarded into this channel. Disable to trade only original signals.

marketEntryTolerance.label: Entry tolerance
marketEntryTolerance.description: Better prices always open at market. Worse prices open at market only while they stay within the configured trader-point tolerance converted from min lot and contract size.

limitOrderHandling.title: If price moves away
limitOrderHandling.subtitle: When a worse price exceeds tolerance, place a limit order at the original entry. If this is off, reject the signal. Better prices still open at market.

enabled.label: Place limit order at original entry
enabled.description: When a worse price exceeds tolerance, place a limit order instead of rejecting the signal.

limitOrderHandling.expirationDescription: Tragram cancels the pending order after this time. Broker expiry may be set later as a backup when the broker requires it.

missingSl.description: Used to calculate an SL when the signal does not include one.

breakEven.title: Break-even
breakEven.subtitle: Move SL to entry once the trade is in profit.
breakEven.disabledForTrailingLevels: Break-even is disabled when trailing follows TP levels.

enabled.label: Enable break-even
enabled.description: Automatically move SL to entry when conditions are met.

offset.label: Lock profit after break-even
offset.description: When break-even triggers, move SL this many pips beyond entry. Use 0 to move SL exactly to entry.

tpHit.label: After TP hit
tpHit.description: Move SL after selected TP is reached.

fixedPips.label: After fixed profit (pips)
fixedPips.description: Move SL after reaching this profit.

trailing.title: Trailing stop
trailing.subtitle: Adjust SL as price moves in your favor.
trailing.enabledHint: Applies to new trades from this channel.

enabled.label: Enable trailing stop
enabled.description: Automatically adjust SL as price moves.

step.label: Step by pips
step.description: After price moves X pips in profit, move SL by Y pips.

tpLevels.label: Follow TP levels
tpLevels.description: Move SL only when TP levels are reached.

tpExecution.title: Take-profit levels
tpExecution.subtitle: Define how TP levels are applied.
tpExecution.allDescription: Apply all TP levels from the signal.

customPercentages.title: Position split by TP
customPercentages.disabledHint: Available only when selected TP levels are used.

toasts.saveError: We couldn't confirm whether your settings were saved. Reload your settings to check before trying again.

validation.maxActiveOrdersMin: Max active trades must be at least 1.
validation.maxDailyTradesMin: Max trades per day must be at least 1.
validation.duplicateSignalTimeoutMinutesMin: Duplicate signal timeout must be at least 1 minute.
validation.riskPerTradePositive: Risk per trade must be greater than 0.
validation.fixedLotSizePositive: Lot size must be greater than 0.
validation.riskPercentageRange: Risk percentage must be between 0 and 100.
validation.maxLotsPositive: Max lot size must be greater than 0.
validation.maxSlPipsPositive: Max SL distance must be greater than 0.
validation.limitOrderExpirationPositive: Limit order expiry must be greater than 0.
validation.marketEntryTolerancePipsPositive: Entry tolerance must be greater than 0.
validation.missingSlPipsPositive: SL distance pips must be greater than 0.
validation.missingSlSymbolInvalid: Each SL override must include a valid symbol.
validation.missingSlOverridePositive: Each SL override must be greater than 0.
validation.breakEvenProfitLockRange: Profit lock pips must be 0 or greater.
validation.trailingStopStepTriggerPositive: Price move trigger must be greater than 0.
validation.trailingStopStepMovePositive: SL move amount must be greater than 0.
validation.breakEvenTpTargetRequired: Select a TP to trigger break-even.
validation.breakEvenTriggerRange: Break-even trigger must be greater than 0.
validation.tpTargetsRequired: Select at least one TP level.
validation.customPercentagesRange: Each TP percentage must be between 0 and 100.
validation.planAllowExecutionWithoutSlTp: Your plan does not allow trades without SL/TP.
